scope: Read-only candidate7-source-final hash and file-set comparison
verdict: No blocking finding in the reviewed delta. Installed candidate8 IME behavior remains to be verified independently.

controlFlowReview.claim: The IME guard is the first handler action; both isComposing and keyCode 229 return before slash/mention menu mutation, preparation and doSend.

First send and existing-thread send use this textarea handler. Existing running-thread queue admission is downstream of threads.send; the nested queue editor reuses Composer with onSend replacement. The guard prevents all these keyboard dispatch paths before persistence or send callbacks.

IME return does not call preventDefault, mutate draft, or set sticky/timed suppression state. An ordinary event with isComposing false and keyCode 13 still reaches the existing Enter or Shift+Enter branches.
Both slash and mention picker branches remain unchanged and receive only non-IME events. IME arrows/confirmation remain with the input method because this handler returns without preventing default.
The component root is a div and action controls use type=button; no native form-submit path was added. Mouse send is unchanged and outside this keyboard-only patch.

testReview.harness: Captures and invokes the real Composer textarea handler through React server rendering; mocks only external runtime hooks/IPC/flush needed by this test. This is not WebKit or an installed IME run.
covered: isComposing true / ordinary Enter key code 13 does not dispatch
isComposing false / legacy key code 229 does not dispatch or preventDefault
meta/control/alt modified legacy IME events do not dispatch
next ordinary Enter sends committed text once without timing gate
Shift+Enter remains default newline and does not prepare/send
disabled editable preparation entry does not prepare on IME confirmation
queueEditing onSend replacement is not called on IME confirmation
slash picker remains unchanged on IME confirmation and selects on the next ordinary Enter without sending
testReview.coverageBoundary: The mention picker and established-thread threads.send are not separately instantiated in this new test; their guard coverage is established by shared source control flow, not claimed as separately executed tests.

limits: No test rerun, production edit, UI action or Agent request by this reviewer.

The test invokes constructed keyboard events and cannot establish which sequence the installed macOS input method emits. Candidate7 actual failure remains evidence; candidate8 installed regression is required.
Only the keyboard handler delta and new regression tests were behavior-reviewed; the rest of the candidate7 manifest was checked by hash and source-tree inventory, not re-audited.
